mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.5% indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals broad-based consumer demand contraction, depressing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1% from their prior 3-month average.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates worsening manufacturing conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually and INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 3.5% signals accelerating inflation, delaying Federal Reserve rate cuts and increasing equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in payroll growth (PAYEMS) indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% from the prior month indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods when RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a further increase in the federal funds rate signals aggressive policy, raising equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25% from the prior month.
